subject: Request: service account inventory + RBAC attestation for SIG review
messages:
From: Alan Mitra <alan.mitra@finservpro.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Cc: security@finservpro.com
Date: Thu, 2 Aug 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: service account inventory & RBAC attestation for SIG

Hi Laura,

Thanks for taking this on. As part of our upcoming SIG review we need the following artifacts so our security team can validate least-privilege enforcement and SCIM provisioning behavior for your tenant:

- Export of all service accounts and machine identities (CSV with account id, owner, last-used, attached roles)
- RBAC role mapping matrix (which role maps to which platform permission)
- SCIM delta logs covering the past 30 days (to verify deprovisioning behavior)
- Transcript of the last automated access certification run or a note on cadence if not available

Can you share a consolidated bundle by EOD 8/9? If any of these are sensitive we can accept a redacted CSV and scoping notes.

Appreciate a short workback so we know who will own each artifact.

Regards,
Alan
FinServPro Security

(attachment: request-checklist.pdf)

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Alan Mitra <alan.mitra@finservpro.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 2 Aug 2028 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: service account inventory & RBAC attestation for SIG

Hi Alan — thanks for the clear list. Looping in Karthik (infra) and Marissa (security/compliance) to coordinate. Proposed plan: 

1) Karthik will pull the service-account export and SCIM deltas and drop artifacts in a secure archive.
2) I will assemble the RBAC matrix and run a quick role-to-permission sampling to call out any overly-broad roles.
3) Marissa will draft the attestation note and confirm the cadence for access certification (quarterly).

I attached a short workback with owners and ETA. If this timeline looks good we'll aim to deliver the bundle to your secure share by 2028-08-09 COB.

A couple of notes: we have some internal service accounts that are managed by automated rotation — those rows will be flagged in the CSV. If you need full raw logs instead of summary we can provide them under an NDA.

Best,
Laura Bennett
Director, Security Programs
Redwood Inference

(attachment: laura_workback_0802.xlsx)

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Alan Mitra <alan.mitra@finservpro.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 2 Aug 2028 11:35:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: service account inventory & RBAC attestation for SIG

Alan / team — quick status update from infra:

- Attached: rbac_export_20280801.csv (includes account id, owner, last_auth, bound_roles)
- Attached: scim-delta-0728.log (30-day delta applied window)
- Attached: service-account-playbook.pdf (internal runbook describing lifecycle + rotation)

Notes and callouts:
- ‘svc-billing-aggregator’ is a long-lived account used in staging + prod; last-used timestamp shows activity from an automation task. We’ve filed a remediation (JIRA SEC-7210) to scope it for role narrowing.
- SCIM deltas show 4 automated deprovisions in the last 30 days tied to offboarding flows.
- The full raw audit log is large; if you want it we’ll ship a gzipped archive via the secure transfer link.

ETA: I’ll upload a single ZIP to the secure share by EOD tomorrow (8/3). If you need a different format (JSON vs CSV) let me know.

Thanks,
Karthik
Sr. Software Engineer, Infra
Redwood Inference

(attachments: rbac_export_20280801.csv; scim-delta-0728.log; service-account-playbook.pdf)

From: Alan Mitra <alan.mitra@finservpro.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 2 Aug 2028 14:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: service account inventory & RBAC attestation for SIG

Karthik — this looks great, thanks for the quick turnaround. The CSV and SCIM deltas are exactly what we need for the SIG scoping review. 

A couple of asks:
- Can you flag accounts that are shared across tenants? (we'll treat those differently)
- Please include the role-mapping matrix Laura mentioned; we want to confirm which permission clusters map to each role.

If you can upload the ZIP to the secure share and post the link here, we'll pull it into our evidence tracker (SEC-4399). EOD 8/9 is acceptable.

—Alan

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Alan Mitra <alan.mitra@finservpro.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 3 Aug 2028 14:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: service account inventory & RBAC attestation for SIG

Alan — uploaded the consolidated package to our secure share: https://redwood-secure-share.example.com/FinServPro/rbac-package-20280802.zip

Contents: rbac_export_20280801.csv (flagged shared accounts), scim-delta-0728.log, role_mapping_matrix.xlsx, attestation_note_quarterly_cert.pdf

We also opened internal tickets for role pruning on the three accounts that surfaced as broad: JIRA SEC-7210, SEC-7211, SEC-7213.

If you need anything else (format changes, raw logs), reply here and we’ll expedite.

Best,
Laura
